consequence.statement: Operators must upgrade sequentially one minor version at a time and be on a v1.20 version before upgrading to v2.0, so CRD migrations run at each minor release.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade sequentially through each v1 minor up to v1.20, then upgrade to v2.0.

original.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 should be done from v1.20, going sequentially through each v1 minor version, because each minor upgrade migrates CRDs so the latest versions are stored.

decision.reason: [ev-8df0afdc905e] describes an operator step to run before the upgrade: Crossplane performs "necessary migrations of its CRDs" at each minor release, so operators should upgrade one minor version at a time and be running v1.20 before going to v2.0. That fits migration-required (a mandatory operator step before the upgrade). The wording is advisory ("strongly advised", "should"), and the evidence does not say what fails if a version is skipped. The proposed statement does not claim any failure, so it does not go beyond the evidence.
